test_df_row: test the polars DataFrame row method to retrieve a single row by index or by predicate
test_df_rows: test the polars DataFrame rows method to retrieve all rows as a list of tuples or named dictionaries
test_df_rows_by_key: test the polars DataFrame rows_by_key method to group rows by one or more key columns into a dictionary
test_df_iter_rows: test the polars DataFrame iter_rows method to iterate over rows with optional buffer size and named output
test_df_row_constructor: test the polars DataFrame constructor with orient=row to build a frame from row-oriented data
